data.long_meaning: In Hindu mythology, Joshik is the name of a deity associated with joy, happiness, and prosperity. He is believed to bestow these blessings upon his devotees. The name Joshik carries the meaning “Joy Giver” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. historical_references.reference: Joshikas were a group of warriors in medieval India who served the Jain monarchs of the Maitrakas and Solanki-Chalukyas dynasties. They were known for their bravery and devotion to their Jain masters.

Joshikas were also a community of traders and merchants in ancient India who were believed to have originated from the region of Kalinga (present-day Orissa). They were renowned for their business acumen and were instrumental in the spread of Buddhism in various parts of India.
